questions.stem: How many ranks does Precision have in Forever?
questions.explanation: Precision drops to 3 ranks for up to +3% hit, and now applies to attacks, spells and poisons. Classic had 5 ranks for 5%.

questions.stem: Which talent's hit chance now also applies to your poisons?
questions.explanation: Blizzard's notes say Malice's crit and Precision's hit now apply to poisons. Lethality and Seal Fate changed point costs but do not touch poisons.

questions.stem: How much Lockpicking skill does the poisons quest need?
questions.explanation: The poisons quest needs 80 Lockpicking. Pick Lock is trained at level 16, and 300 is the Poisons skill cap at level 60.

questions.stem: Which poison do Rogues learn at level 30?
questions.explanation: Crippling comes at 20, Mind-numbing at 24, Deadly at 30 and Wound at 32.

questions.stem: Who starts the Alliance poisons quest chain?
questions.explanation: The chain starts with Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind, sends you to Agent Kearnen in Westfall, and ends at Klaven's Tower with the elite Klaven Mortwake.

questions.stem: Which Alliance racial gives +2% haste?
questions.explanation: High Order Skyborne Wind-Blessed gives +2% haste. Human Ruthless gives +1% crit and Dwarf Artisan's Precision +1% hit.

questions.stem: You want extra hit on your Rogue. Which race's racial gives +1% hit with spells and attacks?
questions.explanation: Dwarf Artisan's Precision gives +1% hit with spells and attacks. Human Ruthless gives crit and Skyborne Wind-Blessed gives haste.

questions.stem: Which Rogue ability no longer blocks a Warrior's Sunder Armor?
questions.explanation: Expose Armor now equals five Sunder Armor stacks and no longer blocks Sunder, so Rogues and Warriors can both add armor reduction.

questions.stem: Which launch raid is the 40-player raid?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps is for 10 players, Hyjal Summit for 20 and Onyxia's Lair for 40; all three open on 9 December 2026.

questions.stem: How much more damage does Mutilate deal against poisoned targets?
questions.explanation: Mutilate deals 20% more damage against poisoned targets. 90% is its weapon damage with each weapon.

questions.stem: With Seal Fate at rank 3 of 3, what chance does a crit from a combo-point ability have to add an extra combo point?
questions.explanation: Seal Fate gives 33%, 66% and 100% at ranks 1, 2 and 3.

questions.stem: At rank 5 of 5, how much does Vile Poisons raise your poison damage?
questions.explanation: Vile Poisons adds 4% poison damage per rank, 20% at rank 5. It also gives poisons up to 40% extra chance to resist dispels.

questions.stem: You are a level 26 Rogue who has done the poisons questline. Which of these poisons can you have learned?
questions.explanation: Mind-numbing comes at 24. Deadly waits until 30 and Wound until 32.

questions.stem: You cast Expose Armor with 5 combo points and Improved Expose Armor at rank 2 of 2. How many combo points come back?
questions.explanation: Improved Expose Armor refunds 1 combo point at rank 1 and 2 at rank 2, only when Expose Armor is cast with 5.

questions.stem: Which Assassination talent can add a combo point to your target after a finishing move?
questions.explanation: Ruthlessness gives finishers a chance to add a combo point. Relentless Strikes restores Energy after finishers, and Seal Fate adds combo points after crits from builders.

questions.stem: How much hit does Precision give at most in Forever?
questions.explanation: Precision gives up to +3% hit over 3 ranks. +1% hit is the Dwarf racial and +1% crit the Human racial.

questions.stem: With Venom, how much does Shank raise your poison damage?
questions.explanation: Venom raises poison damage by 30% and the chance to apply poisons by 20%, for six seconds after Shank.

questions.stem: What does Grilled Squid give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit instead of Agility. Mightfish Steak gives +40 Attack Power.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which elixir is on the melee staples list?
questions.explanation: Elixir of the Mongoose heads the Classic 1.12 melee list. Grilled Squid is on it too, but it is a food, and so is Mightfish Steak.

questions.stem: How many players does Barrow Deeps hold?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps holds 10, Hyjal Summit 20 and Onyxia's Lair 40.

questions.stem: With Improved Kidney Shot at rank 2 of 2, how much more damage does a target stunned by your Kidney Shot take from your poisons and attacks?
questions.explanation: Improved Kidney Shot gives 5% at rank 1 and 10% at rank 2.

questions.stem: You slow a Warrior with Improved Berserker Rage at rank 2 of 2, and they use Berserker Rage. What chance does it have to remove your slow?
questions.explanation: At rank 2 of 2 Berserker Rage has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects. 50% is Mortal Strike's healing cut and 15% Improved Hamstring's highest immobilize chance.

questions.stem: What attack-power coefficient did Blizzard set for Deadly Poison?
questions.explanation: Blizzard raised the coefficients to 0.009 for Deadly Poison and 0.01 for Instant Poison.

questions.stem: Which talent's critical strike chance applies to your poisons?
questions.explanation: Malice's crit applies to poisons. Lethality raises the crit damage of named attacks, and Seal Fate turns crits from builders into combo points.

questions.stem: By how much does Flawless Execution reduce the Energy cost of Eviscerate?
questions.explanation: Flawless Execution reduces Eviscerate's cost by 15 Energy. Efficient Strikes takes 3 or 5 Energy off Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage.

questions.stem: How long does Adrenaline Rush last once used?
questions.explanation: Adrenaline Rush raises your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec. Five minutes is its cooldown.

questions.stem: Which weapons get the extra-attack chance from Hack and Slash?
questions.explanation: Axes and swords get extra attacks, daggers and fist weapons get crit, and maces ignore armor.

questions.stem: Which Combat talent lowers the chance your attacks are dodged or parried?
questions.explanation: Weapon Expertise now lowers the chance your attacks are dodged or parried instead of adding weapon skill.

questions.stem: With Flash of Steel at rank 5 of 5, how much more Energy does Shank generate?
questions.explanation: Flash of Steel adds 3 Energy per rank to Shank, 15 at rank 5, and cuts its cooldown by up to 2.0 sec.

questions.stem: What is Adrenaline Rush's cooldown?
questions.explanation: Adrenaline Rush has a 5 min cooldown. Blade Flurry, which it requires, has a 2 min cooldown.

questions.stem: With Hack and Slash at 5/5, how much armor do your mace attacks ignore?
questions.explanation: At 5/5 maces ignore 15% of armor; 5% is the extra-attack chance for axes and swords and the crit bonus for daggers and fist weapons.

questions.stem: Which racial adds +1% hit?
questions.explanation: Dwarf Artisan's Precision adds +1% hit with spells and attacks; Human Ruthless adds +1% crit.

questions.stem: Which food gives +40 Attack Power in Forever?
questions.explanation: Mightfish Steak gives +40 Attack Power and Grilled Squid +1% crit. Icy Veins says both need an Iron Oven camp object.

questions.stem: How long does Blade Flurry last once used?
questions.explanation: Blade Flurry lasts 15 sec; 2 min is its cooldown.

questions.stem: By how much does a Warrior's Mortal Strike reduce healing on its target?
questions.explanation: Mortal Strike reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

questions.stem: How long is the cooldown that all of a Hunter's traps share?
questions.explanation: All Hunter traps share one 30-second cooldown, and Hunters can lay them in combat.

questions.stem: How much more Rupture and Garrote damage does a target take from you after Hemorrhage?
questions.explanation: Hemorrhage makes the target take 15% more Rupture and Garrote damage from you for 15 sec. 100% and 145% are its weapon damage without and with a dagger.

questions.stem: After how long does Death Mark deal the damage it stored?
questions.explanation: Death Mark deals the stored damage after 6 sec; 10 sec is its cooldown.

questions.stem: With Camouflage at rank 3 of 3, how much shorter is Stealth's cooldown?
questions.explanation: Camouflage cuts Stealth's cooldown by 2 sec per rank and its speed penalty by 5% per rank.

questions.stem: Which abilities does Dirty Tricks make cheaper?
questions.explanation: Dirty Tricks cuts the Energy cost of Sap and Blind. Dirty Deeds is the talent that makes Cheap Shot and Garrote cheaper.

questions.stem: How many combo points does a Boot Knife proc add?
questions.explanation: Boot Knife gives Shank a chance to add 2 combo points. Hemorrhage awards 1.

questions.stem: Within how long must you add to or use Premeditation's combo points?
questions.explanation: Premeditation's combo points are lost after 20 sec; 2 min is its cooldown.

questions.stem: How much Energy does Death Mark cost?
questions.explanation: Death Mark costs 25 Energy. Ghostly Strike costs 40 and Hemorrhage 35.

questions.stem: What does Mightfish Steak give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Mightfish Steak gives +40 Attack Power; Grilled Squid gives +1% crit.

questions.stem: For how long after Ghostly Strike can your next Ambush or Garrote skip Stealth?
questions.explanation: Ghostly Strike's window is 7 sec; 20 sec is its cooldown.

questions.stem: You have used Vanish and Blind in a fight. Which talent finishes their cooldowns at once?
questions.explanation: Preparation finishes the cooldowns on your other Rogue abilities. Elusiveness only shortens Vanish and Blind, and Premeditation adds combo points.

questions.stem: At 5 combo points, how much of your attack damage does Death Mark store?
questions.explanation: Death Mark stores 12% per combo point: 12% at 1, 36% at 3 and 60% at 5, with Garrote and Rupture counted at twice the rate.

questions.stem: What is Death Mark's damage cap at 3 combo points, before Attack Power and crit raise it?
questions.explanation: The caps are 165, 267, 369, 471 and 573 for 1 to 5 combo points, raised by Attack Power and critical strike chance.

questions.stem: With Coup de Grace at rank 3 of 3, how much does Death Mark's damage and storage rate rise?
questions.explanation: Coup de Grace gives 7%, 13% and 20% at ranks 1 to 3, to Eviscerate's damage and to Death Mark's damage and storage rate.
